trackExam.title: Course final exam
trackExam.intro: A timed exam covering the whole course. Pass it and you get a certificate with a public address anyone can check.
trackExam.coverage: Questions are spread across the modules in proportion to their skills, so the exam covers the whole course rather than one corner of it.
trackExam.perSkillCaveat: Each row carries its correct-out-of-total. With two or three questions, one answer moves the percentage far more than it says about you.
trackExam.expired: Submitted after time. We marked it anyway so you can see how you did, but it does not count towards the certificate.

testOut.title: Skip this module
testOut.intro: Show you already know this module and move on without working through it.
testOut.honesty: Every skill in the module gets the same number of questions. Passing does not hand you the module: each answer goes to the engine, and your mastery rises exactly as far as what you showed.
testOut.failedHelp: No harm done: your progress is exactly where it was. Work through the module and come back whenever you like.
testOut.noCertificate: Skipping a module does not earn a certificate. The certificate comes from the course final exam.
